what: the pre-port baseline of LabelPropagation-CUDA@a276a3a alone (PLAN 6.4.7; AD3): never a gate reference (the gates re-measure O in the same session as the port)

reference.name: LabelPropagation-CUDA
reference.build: its own Makefile with the defaults (parity/references.toml: make all bin/propagation_test bin/input_contract_test; ARCH=sm_86, nvcc 13.1, g++ 12.2)

protocol.lock: perf.lock: declared held by the caller (--no-lock / DYNG_PERF_LOCK_HELD=1)
protocol.order: O alone, one process per round
protocol.argv: bench/run.sh's: --quiet --noValidate, the graph files and the labels written into a fresh per-round scratch directory on the same filesystem and deleted after the round (--noGraphFiles only at 50m)
protocol.clocks: the 3-round boost probe's decision per case and schedule (boost if it holds, else base; ADRs 0018, 0021), then 11 rounds at default clocks (recorded)
protocol.contamination_monitor: contaminated rounds repeated (perf_ab.MachineMonitor); triad_perf's audit per reading

protocol.foreign_processes: nvidia-smi before, every 5 s during, after; a reading with a foreign process is not counted
